# openOceanRoute

> Independent MIT-licensed submarine cable route planning project. Application/distribution name: OceanRoute; frozen version: 0.12.1. 独立海底电缆路由规划项目。

The project implements WGS84 geometry, true circular arcs, RPL, GIS reference layers, bathymetry, finite rule checks and bounded cable mechanics research models. It runs as a local browser workspace. The Windows x64 installer bundles Python and dependencies; the source ZIP needs Python and first-install internet access. Git checkouts additionally need an interface build.

The project has no affiliation, authorization or endorsement from Makai. It supplies no Makai license or proprietary software and makes no claim of original-engine equivalence or field certification. MIT covers original code and documentation; third-party rights remain separate. The installer is unsigned and native Windows hardware acceptance is not completed. Existing Windows tests ran under Wine / Rosetta. The application does not implement AI search or AI route planning.

Historical release artifacts remain unchanged. Prefer 0.12.1 over older snapshots, including the 0.12 candidate with known failures.
